summary: Virgin Galactic Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $250 million of common stock (NYSE: SPCE, $0.0001 par) under an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC as sales agent, dated November 12, 2026. Shares may be sold from time to time at-the-market at up to a 3.0% agent commission; last reported sale price was $2.87 on November 11, 2026. Proceeds target working capital, growth initiatives (new launch hangar, rocket production) and debt repayment; the 9.80% First Lien Notes due 2028 indenture requires redeeming at least 35% of net proceeds. No board recommendation or special-situation event; watch dilution and continued ATM drawdowns as an overhang.
